title: Bitcoin’s selloff deepens as Trump tariffs and hot inflation revive market fears
summary: Bitcoin fell to $57,470 on Wednesday as hotter-than-expected US core inflation and the announcement of new tariffs intensified selling across risk assets. The Nasdaq 100 extended its losses to 2.9%, reversing the optimism that followed Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO earlier this week.
